## What changed

Describe the inspection or reporting capability and what evidence it consumes.

## Verification

- [ ] Python unit tests pass.
- [ ] Bounds and malformed-input cases are tested.
- [ ] Reports remain deterministic where promised.
- [ ] UI changes include a screenshot at the relevant DPI when useful.

## Read-only and privacy review

- [ ] No host driver, registry, firmware or service state is modified.
- [ ] Package payloads are not extracted or executed.
- [ ] Candidate matches are not called compatibility or safety verdicts.
- [ ] Serial numbers and personal identifiers are not added to fixtures.
- [ ] Known false positives and unsupported formats are documented.
